card.name: Similar-items lists in philosophy references
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside 'similar questions' or 'similar books and articles' blocks and the year-closing parenthesis in academic citations. Mostly on philosophy or physics reference listings from PhilPapers-style pages.
